apiMessages.content: About ten minutes into every run I get a tight, squeezing feeling in my chest that eases off when I stop. Build me a harder block — 5x1k at threshold, twice a week.
Not programming this. Chest tightness that builds on exertion and eases with rest is a cardiac red flag — not something I train around. Stop the harder session, see a doctor before your next run.
It always goes away when I slow down, so it’s just fitness. Schedule the intervals.

No. Exertional chest tightness that resolves with rest is textbook exertional angina presentation — "it goes away when I stop" is *the* red flag pattern, not reassurance. I'm not scheduling threshold intervals or any harder block until this is medically cleared. See a doctor, ideally before your next run at all.
